subject: Request: quick demo + usage snapshot for Crafterly
messages:
From: Asha Kapoor <asha@crafterly.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo request after signup

Hi Ben,

We just signed up and ran a few tests with Redwood's hosted API — looks promising. I'm Asha (Product at Crafterly). We're evaluating a short pilot to replace our in-house title+description generator for product pages. Before we lock in a pilot, could we do a 30-min demo to run through:

- How batching/prefix caching would work for many short requests
- Expected per-token costs for ~1M tokens/day
- Ops: SSO, access controls, and data retention options

Rough context: catalog enrichment pipeline, low latency needs (user-facing), estimated daily volume ~1M tokens, pilot target: early July with production later in Q3.

Are you available for a 30-min window next week in the mornings (PDT)? Happy to share a small sample dataset.

Thanks,
Asha Kapoor
Product, Crafterly
asha@crafterly.ai
(attachment: screenshot_signup.png)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha@crafterly.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo request after signup

Hi Asha — great to meet you (virtually) and welcome to Redwood. Short answers up front: we can support a 1M tokens/day pilot with predictable latency if we size a small dedicated pool or a hosted variant with prefix caching; SSO and retention controls are available (SOC 2 for enterprise, VPC/private options for later).

A few quick qualification questions so we tailor the demo properly:

1) Primary runtime pattern: are requests single-shot per product (1 call per item) or batched (N items per request)?
2) Peak concurrency: what simultaneous inference requests/sec do you expect at peak? (helps sizing.)
3) Average prompt + generation length (tokens) and typical output length — gives cost estimates.
4) Latency SLO target (p95 in ms) — e.g., 200ms p95 vs 1s p95 changes config.
5) Security needs: do you require VPC/on-prem or will hosted with SOC 2 suffice for the pilot?
6) Any compliance questionnaires we should prepare ahead (PCI/HIPAA/etc)?

If you can drop numbers for the above, Marissa (cc'd) will run a quick cost/ramp back-of-envelope and we'll make the demo concrete.

Suggested 30-min slots (PDT):
- Tue 2028-06-13 10:00–10:30
- Wed 2028-06-14 09:00–09:30
- Thu 2028-06-15 11:30–12:00

Or pick here: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo?month=2028-06

I attached our latest rate sheet and a short pilot checklist so you can see options. If you'd like a deeper technical run-through, Marissa will join as Solutions Engineer.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
(attachment: rate_sheet_v2.pdf)
From: Asha Kapoor <asha@crafterly.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: infra@crafterly.ai
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo request after signup

Ben — thanks for the quick reply and the slots. Answers below: 

1) Runtime pattern: mostly single-shot per product call via our enrichment worker (we can also batch in 10s).
2) Peak concurrency: 600–900 requests/min during catalog refresh windows (~10–15 reqs/sec peak).
3) Average tokens: prompt ~15 tokens, generation ~25 tokens (so ~40 tokens per call average).
4) Latency: we want p95 < 800ms for UX; 99th < 1.5s would be great.
5) Security: hosted with SOC 2 is fine for the pilot; could evaluate VPC later for prod.
6) Compliance: nothing extra for now.

Pilot timing: target week of July 8; ideal pilot start July 12.

I'll take Tue 2028-06-13 10:00–10:30 (first slot). Adding a small sample of 200 product titles for the demo — attachment: sample_batch.csv.

Asha
Asha Kapoor
Product, Crafterly
(attachment: sample_batch.csv)
